We also appreciated the inclusion of disposable cutlery. In the past, we've had issues with other restaurants not providing these items even when requested, so it was a pleasant surprise that Fakht Chinese included them without us having to ask.

Overall, the taste and your service were outstanding. Cheers to your team, and please keep up the excellent work!

featured_reviews.name: drkshaa
featured_reviews.review_text:
It appeared to be a newly opened spa from the board's description. However, Chinese Whisper is actually an Asian Resto by Binny.

It's located on the first floor. The entry way is pretty at night. The interior of the place is similar to an asian night bar resto except they don't have alcohol on their menu.

I along with my veg fren tried their Wok Toss momo which was a little off in taste because of excessive soy sauce. The filling was a mashed mixture of veggies. Later, we tried their Hot Top Ramen which was sooooo good. The soup was flavorful, perfect for the cold winter. I will reccomend them frying the paneer. Soft paneer wasn't complimenting the dish.

All in all as a newly opened Asian resto it's pretty good to chill at night. Can't comment on the authenticity of the Asian cuisine. However, the experience was a 7/10. I will try non-veg soon.

A note from my veg fren: please provide uniform or hire a qualified server. The cute boy doesn't give a good impression of the place.

featured_reviews.name: SANDEEP S NAIR
featured_reviews.review_text:
The best example of a restaurant being run without any passion or commitment towards service or quality.

I visited this place last night for dinner with the expectation of at least decent service and good food, especially since it’s a new restaurant in town. I also noticed a review mentioning “authentic Chinese dishes,” which encouraged me to try it. Unfortunately, the experience was extremely disappointing.

The service staff appeared to be two under-18 kids who had no idea about the menu, the dishes, or basic service etiquette. The food itself was an overload of ginger, garlic, and sauces—nothing close to authentic Chinese cuisine as mentioned in earlier reviews.

Despite the restaurant being almost empty, we had to wait 45 minutes for our food. I also observed at least three other tables giving negative feedback to the same staff due to poor food quality.

My sincere suggestion to the management: build your passion and sincerity first. Focus on serving your guests with care and quality—the money will follow automatically.

featured_reviews.name: The 7th Wanderer
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had visited this place on Saturday eve for a piping hot Soup as the weather was chilling & the following is my unbiased & honest review :

Location : At the Entry of Krishna Complex, available on google maps, not visible from the main road.

Place : Its located on the ground floor, I didnt know about this place until someone suggested me as I was looking for a chicken manchow soup in the area.

Ambience : Well Lit, Nothing too fancy, seating capacity is decent.

Staff : There was only 1 waiter catering to everyone but the service was quick enough. The waiter was polite and catered to all my questions patiently.

Food & Drinks : As the weather was chilling, i needed a piping hot chicken manchow soup and thats what I received. The quantity was good enough & filling and it tasted different, maybe as they dont add MSG (best part), its all mentioned in their menu. For drinks, i could only see some usual beverages in the refrigerator so i didnt bother asking.

Music : There were some good songs being played on the stereo.

Value For Money : Definately Yes ! All the asian cuisine lovers should try this place, im sure it would be worth it.

BitterSweet : None !
